findings.text: the dry-run branch calls _launcher_refusal outside the real branch's BudgetHold/CrewError/OSError handler, even though _launcher_refusal can raise from _backend_settings at line 540; independently reproduced with an eligible waiting pointer carrying launch=cli but no argv or configured backend, where the dry run aborts with CrewError instead of emitting the resume-refused row the real sweep emits, so one malformed candidate can terminate the entire prediction.

the test named every_guard manually enumerates only spawned, live and budget cases and calls the private mirror directly, so it cannot enforce the line 565 promise that a newly added launcher guard is automatically caught and it misses the already-present exception-path asymmetry for an unreadable backend record.

the table presents a 116-test cohort beside one base failure and two after failures as a before/after measure, but the manifest says only two discriminating tests ran at base and marks both suite receipts completed=false; no complete base result exists for the 116-test cohort, so the claimed failure delta is not reproducible from the recorded evidence.

the reviewed commit leaves this focused resumption test failing because its pointer fixture has no launch or argv fields; the manifest correctly attributes and fences the repair as follow-on work, but the merged head must repair the fixture before this cohort is green.

justifications.durability: tests/test_dry_run_predicts_the_launcher.py:118-150 contains a strong budget-hold regression and positive control that pass 7/7 independently, but its finite parity table at line 153 neither follows future resume_plan guards automatically nor covers a guard helper that raises before returning a refusal.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_dry_run_predicts_the_launcher.py passes 7/7 independently and /tmp/after_suite.log records 114 passed with two named failures, but docs/evidence/archive/monitor-renders-what-it-is-given-landed.html:116-119 implies a full cohort delta despite the manifest recording only a two-test base run and completed=false receipts.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/resumption.py:523-599 preserves the launcher's read-only budget decision and shares refusal formatting, but duplicates resume_plan's guard list and calls that mirror outside the exception boundary used by the real path at lines 1052-1062.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/resumption.py:1031-1051 now withholds would_resume for the budget-held case and retains a positive resumable control, but an eligible malformed record can still make the dry run abort instead of reporting what the launcher would report.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit b0547eee changes exactly the four declared paths—reckon/crew/resumption.py, tests/test_dry_run_predicts_the_launcher.py, and the two monitor plan/evidence HTML resources—and carries one conventional commit with a body and no attribution trailer.
